verdict.rationale: Kong's configuration is managed as declarative config through the RESTful Admin API and the decK CLI, and its DB-less deployment model is described as "without any vendor lock-in". AI Gateway telemetry exports as open-standard OTLP metrics. Together this suggests users can move their gateway data out in portable formats, but no source explicitly documents a full export-and-leave workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a config dump/export command and its file format, data export from Konnect SaaS (Catalog, Dev Portal, analytics), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a migration off Kong.
